segments.en: AgroClaw was born as an AgTech assistant in Spanish, with initial focus on the olive grove. segments.source: Esta distinción es clave. Un modelo puede ser suficiente para conversación general, pero quedarse corto cuando debe sostener una jerarquía compleja de instrucciones técnicas. segments.en: That is, perhaps, the best conclusion for this phase. AgroClaw is no longer just an experiment. And in an industry where so much valuable experience lives dispersed among people, campaigns, field visits, photos and notes, that memory can be as important as the agent's own response.
